business_meaning: Days since the latest positive purchase at the cutoff.
source_data: Step 5 invoice-level positive-purchase events within the observation window.
calculation_rule: (cutoff - latest positive invoice-event timestamp) in elapsed days; this reconciles to Step 6 baseline recency.

business_meaning: Number of positive-purchase invoices in the observation window.
source_data: Step 4 positive-purchase base within the observation window.
calculation_rule: Unique Invoice count per customer; line items are not counted as orders.
extreme_value_note: Maximum exceeds P99 by more than 3x; inspect as a long-tail/outlier candidate.

business_meaning: Total positive purchase value in the observation window.
source_data: Step 4 positive-purchase base within the observation window.
calculation_rule: Sum of Quantity * Price across positive-purchase lines.
extreme_value_note: Maximum exceeds P99 by more than 3x; inspect as a long-tail/outlier candidate.

business_meaning: Total units purchased in positive purchases.
source_data: Step 4 positive-purchase base within the observation window.
extreme_value_note: Maximum exceeds P99 by more than 3x; inspect as a long-tail/outlier candidate.

source_data: Monetary and Frequency from the observation window.
extreme_value_note: Maximum exceeds P99 by more than 3x; inspect as a long-tail/outlier candidate.

business_meaning: Mean units purchased per positive invoice.
source_data: TotalQuantity and Frequency from the observation window.
extreme_value_note: Maximum exceeds P99 by more than 3x; inspect as a long-tail/outlier candidate.

business_meaning: Number of calendar dates with a positive purchase.
source_data: Step 4 positive-purchase InvoiceDate within the observation window.
extreme_value_note: Maximum exceeds P99 by more than 3x; inspect as a long-tail/outlier candidate.

source_data: Step 4 positive-purchase StockCode within the observation window.
calculation_rule: Distinct non-null StockCode count per customer.
extreme_value_note: Maximum exceeds P99 by more than 3x; inspect as a long-tail/outlier candidate.

business_meaning: Mean distinct-product intensity per positive invoice.
source_data: Step 4 positive-purchase StockCode and Invoice within the observation window.
calculation_rule: For each invoice, count distinct non-null StockCode values; average those invoice-level counts per customer.

business_meaning: Observable customer history from first observed purchase to cutoff.
source_data: Step 5 invoice-level positive-purchase events within the observation window.
calculation_rule: (cutoff - first positive invoice-event timestamp) in elapsed days; this is not necessarily true lifetime tenure.

business_meaning: Elapsed time between first and last positive purchases in the observation window.
source_data: Step 5 invoice-level positive-purchase events within the observation window.
calculation_rule: (latest positive invoice-event timestamp - earliest positive invoice-event timestamp) in elapsed days.

business_meaning: Mean elapsed time between consecutive positive-purchase invoice events.
source_data: Step 5 invoice-level positive-purchase events within the observation window.
calculation_rule: Mean adjacent timestamp gap per customer; missing when the customer has only one event.
structural_missing_reason: Only one positive-purchase event; no adjacent interpurchase interval exists.

business_meaning: Median elapsed time between consecutive positive-purchase invoice events.
source_data: Step 5 invoice-level positive-purchase events within the observation window.
calculation_rule: Median adjacent timestamp gap per customer; missing when the customer has only one event.
structural_missing_reason: Only one positive-purchase event; no adjacent interpurchase interval exists.

business_meaning: Whether at least two positive-purchase invoice events are observed.
source_data: Step 5 invoice-level positive-purchase events within the observation window.

business_meaning: Number of distinct identified cancellation invoices.
source_data: Step 4 customer-linked cancellation history within the observation window.
calculation_rule: Unique cancellation Invoice count per customer.
extreme_value_note: Maximum exceeds P99 by more than 3x; inspect as a long-tail/outlier candidate.

business_meaning: Absolute monetary value represented by identified cancellation lines.
source_data: Step 4 customer-linked cancellation history within the observation window.
calculation_rule: Sum of abs(Quantity * Price) across cancellation lines; cancellations are not netted against purchases.
extreme_value_note: Maximum exceeds P99 by more than 3x; inspect as a long-tail/outlier candidate.

business_meaning: Whether at least one identified cancellation invoice is observed.
source_data: Step 4 customer-linked cancellation history within the observation window.

business_meaning: Share of identified purchase/cancellation invoices that are cancellations.
source_data: Observation-period positive purchases and customer-linked cancellations.
calculation_rule: CancellationInvoiceCount / (Frequency + CancellationInvoiceCount); denominator is valid because both terms count distinct invoices.

business_meaning: Raw customer-level country candidate based on observation-period purchases.
source_data: Step 4 positive-purchase Country within the observation window.
calculation_rule: Most frequent observed country per customer; unique top country required, with deterministic lexical ordering only as a tie audit.
